title: Read the supplied FFI demonstration
description: You can follow the given foreign-function call representation, lookup, and test harness.

steps.description: FfiExpr stores a module name, function name, and argument list. SAFE_MODULES supplies the module lookup table.
eval_ffi looks up the module and named attribute before calling it. Missing entries raise the displayed exception types.
The supplied parsing simulation captures module and function text, then converts numeric argument text to floats.
